title: Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure
abstract: arXiv:2611.19609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patc

translated_title: 词之前：小语言模型描述导出状态中的名称信息——命名成功与命名失败的对比研究
translated_abstract: 舌尖现象（TOT）状态——即知道一个物体却无法说出其名称——仅作为类比启发了本研究。我们探讨小型语言模型是否能从无名称的描述中形成一个可用于预测名称的状态，以及当命名失败但描述选择成功时，该状态是否有所不同。在一项内部预注册的研究（冻结文档，无外部注册）中，我们对Qwen2-0.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B和Phi-3-mini三个模型进行了200个项目的实验，结合了相似度读出、Patchscopes式读出以及带有匹配对照的激活补丁技术。假设1（状态中包含名称信息）在全部九种模型-描述类型组合中均得到支持；相似度测量与激活补丁共同满足了约定的判定规则，而Patchscopes则接近随机水平。内部审查后的事后稳健性检查（logit lens、单位置补丁、操纵检查）缓和了这一解读：中间层的名称信息在多位点补丁条件下最为清晰。
tldr: 本研究通过对三个小语言模型的实验发现，模型能从无名称的描述中形成包含名称信息的内部状态（经相似度读出与激活补丁验证），该信息在中间层的多位点补丁下最为清晰，而Patchscopes读出则接近随机水平。
en_tdlr: This study shows that small language models form internal states containing name information from name-free descriptions, as verified by similarity read-out and activation patching (clearest in middle layers under multi-position patching), while the Patchscopes read-out remains near chance.
